items.title: Russian vessels reportedly begin clearing debris from damaged Crimean Bridge
items.summary: At least ten vessels, including tugs and a dredger, were reportedly operating around the damaged Crimean Bridge after the collapse of a road section into the Kerch-Yenikale Canal. Ship-tracking observations suggest smaller vessels may still be able to pass, while crews appear to be working to clear debris from the waterway.

items.title: Russia's FSB detains two men over alleged intelligence work for Ukraine
items.summary: Russia's Federal Security Service says it arrested two residents of Khabarovsk Krai suspected of collecting information on industrial sites and military personnel for Ukrainian intelligence. The agency alleges one suspect obtained drone-control equipment and training for possible sabotage; a treason investigation has been opened.

items.title: Strikes reportedly hit energy and administrative sites in Odesa
items.summary: Explosions were reported in Odesa, with local accounts alleging that one strike hit an energy facility and another struck an administrative building. The report did not establish the extent of damage or any casualties.

items.title: Russian drone unit reports attacks on Ukrainian energy and logistics facilities
items.summary: A Russian unmanned-systems brigade reportedly carried out Geran-4 drone strikes against a logistics centre, a combined heat-and-power plant and a drone-storage facility. Footage was circulated purporting to show the attacks, but precise locations and damage assessments were not provided.

items.title: Russian diplomat warns of response to possible nuclear deployments in Eastern Europe
items.summary: A Russian delegation representative in Vienna warned that easing restrictions on nuclear-weapon deployments in Lithuania, Poland or other European countries would prompt countermeasures by Moscow's strategic deterrence forces. The remarks described a potential response rather than an announced deployment.
